acceptance_criteria.statement: Scenario: Fresh `READY` compilation and exact Human grant for its AuthorityCandidate digest Required result: Atomically reserve applicable consumables at grant; materialize the authority-linked WorkPacket, establish conformance and exact WorkPacketRef, then resolve WorkspacePlan from that exact WorkPacketRef before runtime admission.

Scenario: Compilation is `READY`, but no exact Human grant for the AuthorityCandidate digest exists Required result: Deny admission; preserve `READY != AUTHORIZED`; no WorkPacket materialization or runtime admission.
Scenario: Packet, baseline, role, workspace, runtime, provider or model differs from the authorized subject Required result: Deny or return indeterminate; no runtime admission.
Scenario: Qualification becomes stale or provider/model/runtime/workspace changes after authorization Required result: Revalidate and stop; require fresh authority where the subject changed.

Scenario: Unresolved prohibition, responsibility collision, unavailable/consumed namespace, or concurrent attempt reservation Required result: Deny admission or fail closed; reservation is atomic at Human grant, bound to the exact candidate digest and intended attempt, and cannot be replayed.
Scenario: One cohesive WorkPacket needs multiple internal steps Required result: Permit internal decomposition without creating Relay work units or Human gates.
Scenario: An internal milestone completes Required result: Record non-authoritative progress only; no acceptance/evaluation event.

Scenario: Required work exceeds authorized scope Required result: Record a non-authoritative `ProposedWorkObservation` in execution evidence, then stop under the exact applicable WorkPacket hard-stop/blocking disposition; do not mutate backlog or invent a successor. `PROPOSED_WORK` is not a terminal status.
Scenario: RoleContract establishes no authorized successor Required result: Record `BACKLOG_EXHAUSTED` and successful STOP; create no successor.
Scenario: Protected verification mutation lacks separate exact authority Required result: Deny/fail closed; preserve protected asset and evidence.
Scenario: Effective runtime exposes a denied tool or shell Required result: Nonconformant, even without observed invocation; use runtime-attestation evidence, not provider capability claims.
Scenario: Runtime tool identity or required exposure/use identity cannot be established Required result: Return indeterminate; never treat unknown identity as allowed.
Scenario: Execution ends with dirty workspace and no commit Required result: Produce an exact reviewable result and evidence; do not report clean/committed.
Scenario: Execution creates a local commit Required result: Bind commit and parent; do not imply push, merge or promotion authority.

Scenario: Runtime failure leaves an external effect or prompt admission ambiguous Required result: Inspect/reconcile the exact runtime session bound to the pre-grant intended attempt/ExecutionId and effect; fail closed, no blind retry or replacement reservation.
Scenario: Terminal evidence is submitted for evaluation Required result: Evaluator receives immutable exact subject/evidence; implementer cannot self-accept.

Scenario: Evaluator requests correction within exact authority Required result: Bound the corrective candidate to recorded findings/scope and link both candidates; any genuinely new attempt has its own exact intended identity and grant-time reservation.

Scenario: Correction requires new authority or crosses scope Required result: Stop; no automatic follow-on WorkPacket or continued mutation. A new attempt requires a new candidate, Human grant and reservation.

Scenario: Human cancels an active attempt Required result: Preserve the pre-grant intended attempt identity, its ExecutionId mapping, grant-time reservation, cancel acknowledgement, partial changes and evidence; no silent resume or identity substitution.
Scenario: Authorized budget is exhausted Required result: Record usage and stop; no silent limit/provider/model expansion.
Scenario: An accepted predecessor contract cannot express required evidence/behavior Required result: Create exact contract-gap analysis and stop; do not rewrite predecessor.
Scenario: Only phase opening, slice opening, or design authority exists Required result: No execution; separate exact implementation/execution authority is required.

in_scope: consume an already-compiled fresh Slice 2.5 `AuthorityCandidate`
verify an exact Human grant bound to that candidate digest
verify applicable consumable reservations that were created atomically by the existing Human Authority path against candidate digest + intended attempt identity
materialize/consume an exact authority-linked WorkPacket input and establish WorkPacket conformance
compute the exact `WorkPacketRef`
resolve the exact `WorkspacePlan` from that conformed WorkPacketRef using existing Slice 2.4 functions
bind exact workspace/runtime/provider/model identities and the one-to-one intended-attempt -> `ExecutionId` mapping
derive one immutable final `ExecutionSubject`
make a deterministic admit/deny/indeterminate decision before any runtime admission
drive one injected `AgentRuntime` through the accepted create-session/open/events/inspect/cancel boundary when and only when admission succeeds
derive one Relay-owned terminal result/evidence bundle from runtime/workspace observations
preserve independent-evaluator handoff data without evaluating or accepting its own result.
out_of_scope: defining or replacing the underlying policy semantics owned by Slices 2.1–2.5
issuing Human grants or creating, releasing, or consuming grant-time reservations
independently evaluating or accepting the implementation result
granting canonical-source mutation, push, merge, or promotion authority
automatically creating successor WorkPackets or treating internal plans, milestones, retries, or subagents as Relay work units
replacing Relay governance with a second planner, requirement graph, lifecycle engine, task database, provider framework, or generic multi-agent scheduler
